description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Mariyasebastiyampillai Amaladorin as Vice Chairman of the Delft P/S - Vacated the office of Member of the Poonakary P/S by Mr. Ponnampalam Siriskantharasa
reasoning: This gazette contains two notices related to local government elections processes. The first notice declares the election of a new Vice Chairman for the Delft Pradeshiya Sabha to fill a vacancy under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The second notice declares that a member of the Poonakary Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated office due to ceasing membership in a political party. Both notices fall under electoral processes and vacancy declarations for local authorities, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) covering electoral matters, candidate registrations, and declarations related to local government elections.
